risks.title: Supplier Concentration and Supply Chain Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on its top 10 suppliers (85% of purchases), including Carrier (62%) and Rheem (8%), creating significant vulnerability in case of disruption

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces cybersecurity threats that could compromise its critical information systems and damage its reputation

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a fragmented competitive environment with over 2,100 distributors, where pricing and quality pressures are strong

risks.title: Economic Downturn Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks related to deteriorating economic conditions that could reduce demand for HVAC/R products

risks.title: Natural Disaster and Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks from natural disasters and trade tensions that could disrupt operations or increase costs

risks.title: Information Systems Dependency Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on its information systems to manage operations, its 695 locations, and relationships with 130,000 contractors

risks.title: Regulatory Compliance Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company must comply with evolving environmental and energy efficiency regulations, particularly regarding new low-GWP refrigerants

ai_positioning.summary: WSO does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related topics in its 10-K filing, indicating no current disclosure on the subject.
